Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.model

Record Class PerplexityCitation

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.model.PerplexityCitation
Record Components:
citationId - UUID primary key
companyId - FK to HealthcareAiCompany (nullable for discovery calls)
url - the cited source URL
context - snippet or context around the citation
callType - which pipeline phase produced this citation
retrievedAt - when the citation was retrieved from Perplexity
public record PerplexityCitation(String citationId, String companyId, String url, String context, CompanyCallType callType, Instant retrievedAt) extends Record
Immutable domain record representing a citation logged from a Perplexity API call during the company discovery pipeline.

Every Perplexity API call (discovery, extraction, validation) produces citations — URLs cited by the model as sources for its claims. This record captures each citation for audit traceability of factual claims.
